testing_setup: Set up a pytest framework for this Flask app without changing application code. Add tests/, conftest.py with a test client fixture, and baseline tests for every existing route.
unique_solution: Add a count_solutions(board, limit=2) backtracking function and only remove a cell during puzzle generation if the puzzle still has exactly one solution.
difficulty_levels: Map difficulty names to target clue counts (easy 40, medium 32, hard 26) and validate the incoming difficulty against the allowed set, defaulting to medium.
session_refactor: Replace the module-level state dict with Flask session storage, explaining why globals break with concurrent users and multiple tabs.
event_delegation: Attach a single input listener to the board container and use event delegation instead of one listener per cell.
top10_localstorage: Write saveScore and renderLeaderboard functions that keep the fastest 10 entries sorted ascending by time in localStorage, wrapped in try/catch, with the player name escaped before DOM insertion.
alternating_boxes: Alternate the background of each 3x3 box using a class applied per cell from box index parity computed in JS, with colors as CSS custom properties so it works in both themes.
dark_mode: Add a dark mode toggle that sets data-theme on <html>, persists to localStorage, and respects prefers-color-scheme on first load.
accessibility_audit: Audit against WCAG 2.1 AA: ARIA labels per cell, arrow-key navigation, aria-live status regions, visible focus rings, 4.5:1 contrast, and no color-only state.
explain_before_accept: Explain what this suggested code does line by line, and tell me what tradeoffs or edge cases it introduces, before I accept it.
rejected_client_side_solution: REJECTED: caching the puzzle solution in localStorage for faster hints. Any player could read the full answer from DevTools. Solution stays server-side in the Flask session.
